title: Formally unramified morphisms restrict to open subschemes
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a formally unramified morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. Let $U\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq S$ be open subschemes with inclusions $j_U:U\to X$, $j_V:V\to S$ (open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion]) such that $f(U)\subseteq V$, and let $f|_U:U\to V$ be the unique morphism with $j_V\circ f|_U=f\circ j_U$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme]. Then $f|_U:U\to V$ is formally unramified.
